capture_detail: final cover via tools/capture.mjs at authored params (count 62000); draft inspection of all 36 scenes at count 8000 via the scratch setScene driver (see notes)
notes: Grammar: one governing formation per record carrying its declared operation; the record's own load-bearing notation appears as text sources only where the record states it (A06 speech descent, A13 '/ = −/−', '(−1)/(+1)', '(0/1)/(1/0)', A14 process words, A18 eight-determination traversal, A21 'x→X→x', A34 order of dependence, A14′ 'ℝ²/ℤ²', A36′ 'AGI → AHI').
Status-as-data: kicker carries '<record id> · <CLAIM_STATUS>'; palette accent encodes status (Argued/Derived/Offered) — presentation policy recorded in the family profiles, never a semantic claim.

CENSUS RECONCILIATION FINDING (returned to E0): every sha256 in census receipt T25-current-census-acceptance.json for these 72 records was computed at commit 82446f6 (T22) and no longer matches the files at the pinned revision dbf3b17, where content changed at 5c22906 (T23/T24 repair). Bindings therefore carry both hashes: sha256_census_receipt (as the packet instructs) and sha256_working_dbf3b17 (verified on disk). Record ids, canonical homes and register/type in the census match.

SHARED TOOL DEFECT (returned to Point-Cloud-Demo #6): tools/capture.mjs --all-scenes calls window.__FIELD_STUDIES__.openScene(...), which no longer exists in the presentation build (current API: setScene(index)); switching is a silent no-op and all-scenes captures drift on the journey autoplay clock (verified by probe: hasOpenScene=false). Draft per-scene captures for this pass were made with a scratch driver (/tmp) using the same server + window.__JOURNEY__ injection path and setScene + sceneIndex polling; final covers used tools/capture.mjs itself (first scene, which is faithful).

Craft: entity sequences were lengthened (holds 3.4–5.2s) after draft inspection showed stills catching transition smears; word-carrying scenes (A06/A14/A34) run quieter fields (lower speed/turbulence) so letterforms hold. Residual: a still of a live sequence can catch a morph; in motion the operation reads.

Room routing: argument→room/movement refs merged from the rooms' P1-CANONICAL-ALIGNMENT.md files and movement consumers declared inside the record bodies (A05: M07·M13·M48; A06: M29·M30·M44 + M38·M42 philosophical returns); each source is per-record in the scenes array.
E0 acceptance repair: relation-block overlap fixed on a01p (cover) and a30p; relations now wrap in a dedicated 290px left-margin layer on all 36 scenes.

Enrichment moves 2026-10-06 (per scene; A′ treatment is print/cool/technological — different means from A's ink warmth, same floor): a01p square→yantra→square on the frame with a square-wave scale tick: the decomposable assemblage read through and recovered as one frame; repel pulse holds the appearance's boundary. a02p is→was→is micro-shifts: continuity as maintained identification across sessions; orbital relational ties the two deployments; attract pulse holds the instance. a03p account→its own act→account: the account entering the process it describes, the returning account smaller (the gap recurs through successful disclosure); wider repel. a04p mask→document on the view square with rotation and heavier tint: the mask read as legible record, not stripped; quiet attract; slow orbital. a05p light→camera→action on Vimarśa's ring, action solidifying to disc: the staging's three offices; resonance 200 Hz — appearing held by its organisation. a06p Parā Vāk→formative vision→inner articulation→issued expression marching down the page: the technological descent (the issued instruction as achieved expression); square-wave excitation automation is the digital issue. a07p vikalpa→saṃkalpa→metric→script, the script step frozen small and repelling: the metric is one saṃkalpa; Script is the frozen extreme. a08p selection→contrast field→recovery: exclusion that remembers — the contrast recoverable at judging grain; strong repel pulse keeps the corridor's tension. a09p the stack as descent: active context→capacities→retained interactions→purposes→relational milieu descending and shrinking on Chakra Body layout with travelling focus — lamination, not floors. a10p uncounted→inscribed→operative with ink rising faint→full: the uncounted entering the account; shove click — the accounting ruptures. a11p 0/1↔1/0 swaps on the two faces of one field; the mark pair read as mutual niche; relational on, attract. a12p diversity→homophily→collapse, collapse shrinking and repelling: the monoculture vector staged; mid attract. a13p / = −/− → (−1)/(+1) → (−1)+(+1)=0 → (0/1)/(1/0) while the poles cut apart and gather: orchestration's dia and syn; vortex pointer, tighter radius. a14p THE QUOTIENT SEQUENCE — ℝ²/ℤ² → (x,y) ∼ (x+m,y+n) → the torus → 0/1 on the cymatic plate with resonance: code as the age's logos, the record's own construction in order. a15p ratio→criterion→benchmark→training on the measure ring: the measure constituting its performances; gentle attract keeps the prediction-stability quiet. a16p observer/object triangles placed from coincidence: the sensorium as the Arche-Topos placing; stillness pointer — no view from nowhere, and none from everywhere either. a17p THE 3D SCENE — real-to-sim-to-real traversal: z is the lift onto the covering path; descriptive→predictive→speculative returns to its address displaced (local return retains global displacement); depth perspective+occlusion+cool tint; saw-wave lift automation; yaw pair is the evidence. a18p the eight determinations run in code with tighter transitions (0.6s) and a square-wave speed automation: the traversal as executed run; travelling focus. a19p local settlement→the field's criterion (growing): the usurping gesture of the local regime; orbital basin, attract with high recovery. a20p persona→profile→embedding→shadow-self: the image's precise technical names in order, the shadow-self snapping to full ink and pulling — the loop closed; snapRigidity up. a21p x→X→x with the nucleation swell and a displaced, smaller return: individuation with recognition, never terminal; low attract. a22p deployment→fork→atlas across the travelling charts: the atlas, not the camera; faint pointer — the frames stay placed. a23p entrustment→reliance→withdrawal on the ring with stepwise anchor micro-adjustment: trust as situated, revisable undertaking; attract. a24p THE CRITERION STACK — retrieval rank→reward model→engagement metric→policy→benchmark with rising repel strength: the stack of criteria, the last ceasing to know itself as local; shove click. a25p source→scope→means of return on the office disc: typed authority's triple; moderate attract, lowered circulation — authority received. a26p stages the other face’s recognition sequence — 0→Ø→X→Ø/X→(0/Ø)/(1/X)→1 ↺ 0/1 — which belongs to A26 (stated verbatim in the A26 record citing the shared A/C root, conjugate/AC.md; A26′ itself carries only 1/0 as formal notation) and reaches a26p through the declared A26↔A26′ other-face relation, not as A26′s own notation: inverted disc/ring forms and quicker transitions (the essay inside the film, the lens taking itself as object); low repel keeps offices distinct. a27p self and Other breathing out of phase on saw waves: reciprocity without symmetry; stillness pointer — encounter over sovereignty. a28p prompt→role→tools→criteria on the delegate: the authored session's strata, the prompt already 1; gentle attract. a29p contribution→return→extraction with extraction repelling hard at full ink: delegation's pathology staged as disappearance of return; square-wave down/up alternation is the omnidirectional circuit. a30p nesting→federation on the second world: shared worlds, unmerged; relational on; low attract. a31p the five sites — answer→task interpretation→world-model→evaluator→commission — growing and turning stepwise: deference's co-evolutionary sites; strong attract. a32p exteriorise→return→stage marching right on the mirror with the morph clock on 'beat': the mirror is a film — frames returning as conditions; low vortex. a33p claimed difference→the gate→discriminated consequence (grown): parity's gate; low repel. a34p Subjective Immediacy→Objective Internality→World marching through positions: the direction of dependence in the conjugate's own terms; travelling focus; stillness. a35p inherited world→the return→commons (smaller, lighter): the commons behind the system, returned without consuming; soft attract. a36p 0/1→1/0→0/1 while AGI→AHI crosses below: integral zero of the hybrid society — the exact signs becoming Symbol; calm strong attract closes the family.
